text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp—Gran Alegria's training
was progressing smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —How was my time?
choice_data_list: The gap closed again!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! I've totally got the hang
of running barefoot on the beach now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her high adaptability greatly enhanced
the effectiveness of the beach training.
choice_data_list: Well then, that's all for this morning.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes, great work!
Looking forward to the afternoon as well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria grew during this training camp.
Not just in speed, but in muscle and stamina too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her natural aptitude seems good enough for medium distances, but...
training and actual racing are two completely different things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There are still too many uncertainties to consider medium distance just yet.
choice_data_list: (The issue is our training plan going forward...)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
your lunch is getting cold, you know?
choice_data_list: —Eh? Ah...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter?
...Is something troubling you?
choice_data_list: No, I was just too focused on work, that's all

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's focus on eating now!
We're gonna run out of time!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
“—Well then, I'll go check on each room.
Please handle the patrol outside.”
choice_data_list: Yes. See you later, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A rest day during the training camp. With training off,
the Umamusume can spend their time freely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Going out is permitted if you submit a request.
However, some students sneak out without submitting one,
which is why she makes the rounds to check their rooms like this.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah, crap. Everyone, hide!
choice_data_list: Huh? That voice just now...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Will it be all right?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm okay.
Since Trainer went over to the other side...
choice_data_list: Where do you think you're sneaking off to?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oops.
Looks like she cut behind the dorms and headed us off...
choice_data_list: None of you submitted an off-campus pass, did you?
You all didn't submit your outing request forms, did you?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, the truth is, we just decided
to go a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Would you like to come along too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good idea.
If Trainer is with me, I won't even need a leave pass♪
choice_data_list: No, I'm in the middle of my patrol.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Even after your patrol is over is fine!
Just to clear your head, okay?

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you accompany them?
I'll take over the patrol for you.
choice_data_list: No way! I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, sneaking out is part of the fun of training camp.
Isn't that what youth is all about?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, that's youth for ya!

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text: Well, you'll still have to submit an apology letter later, though.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... I suppose so...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I have two candidates for where to go, but I can't decide.
Making soba noodles from scratch, or a pottery-painting workshop.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Which one are you interested in, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Powerful Soba-Making Experience
Take Your Time Painting Pottery

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Looks like you prefer food over art too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: The secret to making soba is speed! If you take your sweet time, the water mixed into the flour will evaporate!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to quickness, I'm good up to 60 miles!
Alright then, add the powder—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
P-Please wait! G-Gran-chan,
I think we should measure the ingredients properly...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But if you take your time measuring it,
won't the water evaporate?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Let's split up the tasks♪ Chrono-chan can measure, and Gran-chan can mix. How about that?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I think... that's a good idea.
I'll—help with taking the measurements.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mix it evenly, keep mixing—
Chrono-chan, water, please!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes, adding the second batch of 100 cc!
choice_data_list: Oh, in total sync!
Wow, you're perfectly in sync!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It kinda looks like pounding mochi, though.
Still, your handiwork is amazing, Gran-chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Just by watching the master make noodles once...
she seems to have grasped the knack of it.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Chrono-chan measured out all the ingredients
with total precision, so it's bound to be perfect♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: When kneading, press it against the bowl, right? Let's speed it up by 5 miles!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Eieieieieiiiyk!
choice_data_list: I-It looks like these soba noodles are going to have a wonderfully firm texture!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, soba certified delicious by the master himself was ready!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it turned out looking delicious.
Let us dig in right away.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: My Rule: "If I split my chopsticks cleanly, I get a second serving of soba"! Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One half of Gran Alegria's split disposable chopsticks had broken off into the shape of an axe...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Please swap chopsticks with me.
choice_data_list: Sure.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, thank you very much!
I'm gonna eat until I'm eighty percent of a mile full~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho, prioritizing art over appetite, are we?
How like a diligent Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: So all I have to do is paint this pure white cow doll, right? Easy-peasy♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: The body definitely has to be red!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
All doooone!
Next we draw the face, right!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Gran-chan!
Let it dry properly first.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
…………
Well then, I think that's enough!
choice_data_list: No way, it hasn't even been three minutes yet?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Well, it'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—It's complete.
Looks like I'm the last one. I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's Bouquet-san's...
The flower pattern is so cute...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Sprinkled with colorful flowers...
It looks just like a bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes, I modeled it after a bouquet. And the eyelashes are a key point too♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mine...
ended up kind of patchy.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Oh dear. You layered on more paint before it dried, so the colors ended up mixing together.
choice_data_list: Still, you look like a visual kei rocker! Super cool!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Visual kei... I see!
Now that you mention it, it does look kinda like makeup!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu,
it's nice to experience art once in a while, isn't it!
